examples.arabic: الاب بص ليها بابتسامة وقال ايوه عندك حق يا بنتي اسألي زي ما انتي عايزه
examples.english: The father looked at her with a smile and said 'yes, you are right my daughter, ask as much as you want.'
examples.transliteration: El ab bass leeha bebtesama we 'al aywa andek haqq ya benty es'aly zay ma enty ayza

examples.arabic: عندك حق طب تعالي اشربي معايا شاي
examples.english: You are right. Come, drink tea with me then.
examples.transliteration: ʿAndek ḥaʾʾ. Ṭab taʿālī ishrabī maʿāya shāy.

examples.arabic: عندك حق يا ام احمد الاجيال بتتغير والافكار كمان
examples.english: You're right, Umm Ahmed, generations change and so do ideas.
examples.transliteration: ʿAndik ḥaqq ya Omm Aḥmed el-agyāl bettaghayyar w el-afkār kamān.
